description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Lantern of Insight.
Cast Lantern of Insight from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Kykar
Mirran Spy and Kykar trigger
Resolve the Mirran Spy trigger, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Kykar trigger, creating a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {R}.
Activate Lantern of Insight by tapping and sacrificing it, causing target player to shuffle their library.
Repeat.
